history.summary: Small 506 sqft freehold 1BR at Casa Cambio (D19 Serangoon) at $868K / $1715 PSF, just below the $1752 median, with a steady 3.83% CAGR over a reliable 45-txn series and 710m to Serangoon MRT (NE12). Low quantum and freehold are positives, but a 1BR is a niche, shallow-pool asset and the boutique block's weak Elo (1252) signals limited resale strength.
history.rating_rationale: Sub-$900K freehold near a major interchange (NE12, NEL/CCL) is genuinely affordable and the 3.83% CAGR (45 txns) is dependable. But 1BR units have the shallowest buyer/tenant pool, the development's 1252 Elo and 162-141 record indicate it loses most head-to-head matchups, and entry is at-median (no discount). Fine as a low-ticket yield play, but the niche unit type and weak competitive profile cap it at Neutral.
red_flags: 1BR — shallowest buyer and tenant pool, niche exit
Weak Elo (1252) and near-even record — soft competitive standing
Entry at district median PSF — no value cushion
catalysts: Freehold sub-$900K quantum near Serangoon interchange (NE12, NEL+CCL)
PDD/CRL lifting the broader D19 over the hold
